title: Gridiron Grit - Demo Release
author: GridIron-Grit
selftext:
Good day devs!

  
If you're a American Football fan and a sim genre enjoyer come check out Gridiron-Grit on Steam! 

  
The demo covers the full featured first year - up to week 1 of the 2028 season. 

  
Still looking for some modders to get the Workshop section going to reskin the teams and players. 

  
All feedback comes right to me with an F9. 

  
Let me know if you get hooked or what you hate! 

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4887480/Gridiron\_Grit/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4887480/Gridiron_Grit/)

Happy to speak on my workflow or testing philosophy for growing the game engine and simulation itself (tested at 30year lengths).
